Health Hub admin on this phone

This CuraX app mode is for administrators who run a Health Hub: you invite or approve users, see hub alerts, review reports, and can open someone\'s schedule when they need help (Care mode). It is not the same as the standard patient or user home — the bottom tabs and drawer are built around roster management and oversight.

• Dashboard — snapshot counts, charts, recent activity, and shortcuts into other tabs. • Users — everyone linked to your hub, their mode (default vs standalone), relay or desktop readiness, Care mode, and refresh. • Alerts — filterable list of alerts for your workspace. • Reports — exports (for example CSV or PDF) and analytics views. • Connections — pending link requests, refresh, and your invite or connection code to share so people can join your hub.

Open the menu (☰) for hub shortcuts and the Connection panel. Tap Connect once — Android permissions and relay auto-reconnect are saved. After that, alerts keep flowing when the app is closed (stay online; do not Force Stop CuraX).

From the three-dot menu, then Settings, you can set or change PIN and auto-lock; export chat or alert history; open My app info (Bot ID and API key for support); view My connection code (the code people enter when linking their mobile app to your hub); create a Desktop linking code (one-time code for your own CuraX desktop program on a PC — see the next card); and reopen this Help.

• One-time code links your CuraX desktop (PC) to this admin login.
• Enter it in the desktop app where it connects to your hub.
• For your own large-screen workflow — not for inviting mobile users.
• Patients use your invite or connection code from Connections or sign-up.
• Codes expire quickly and work once.
